spans.s: deyadharma, m. (= Pali deyyadhamma, primarily adj. and may have nt. gender, AN 〔i.166.12〕 deyyadhammaṃ, n. sg., see comm. 〔ii.265.32, 266.3〕), meritorious gift, lit. having the quality of something that should be given: ˚ma-parityāgāt Mv 〔ii.276.10〕, as a result of having given meritorious gifts; ˚ma-parityāgena Av 〔ii.117.4〕; ˚maṃ, acc., Mv 〔iii.426.6〕; (ayam) asya ˚mo yat tathāgatasya pāṃśvañjaliḥ pātre prakṣiptaḥ Divy 〔369.3〕; bhagavacchāsane sarvadeyadharmāḥ samucchinnāḥ Av 〔i.308.6〕.
